args.subject: Group Booking Availability – 10 Guests in June 2024
args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am organising a group stay at City Hub Tokyo and would like to enquire about availability for a party of 10 people in June 2024.

Could you please let me know:
- Whether you have availability for 10 guests during June 2024
- The dates for which rooms or group rates would be available
- Any group rates, package options, or minimum-stay requirements you can offer
- Whether you can accommodate room configurations for 10 guests (including any twin/room-share arrangements)
- Any deadlines for securing a group booking

If you could also send through the booking terms, deposit requirements, and cancellation policy, that would be very helpful.

For reference, my contact details are:
Emma Johnson
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
